result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out, but the Smash Bros Burgers card shows a broken delivery fee ('€NaN delivery'), which is a clear data or rendering error. Two minor issues were also noted: a redundant free-delivery label and low-contrast placeholder text. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were treated as intended scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays '€NaN delivery', indicating the delivery fee failed to calculate or render and shows an invalid value to users.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee calculation or data mapping so a valid amount is shown, and add a fallback such as 'Delivery fee unavailable' or hide the fee when the value is missing.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card repeats the free-delivery information: a '€0 delivery' badge sits on the image and '€0 delivery' appears again in the metadata line.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in only one location to reduce clutter.

issues.description: The search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and the grey secondary text (delivery fees, 'Fastest near you' labels) appear light grey on a light background, which may fall below recommended contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder and secondary text colours to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1.
